evaluation_protocol.selection: Within each gold class take first N SHA256(seed + query_id UTF-8), lexical tie break; order selected IDs by the same key.
evaluation_protocol.scope: Public stratified small evaluation; not hidden, unseen, or the full official test; sample membership frozen before model calls.

clock_identity.sampling: time.monotonic then time.time_ns; sequential local calls, not atomic
clock_identity.scope: Observed clock differences only; no sleep attribution, no historical latency correction.

user_flow_metrics.scope: ready answer, structurally valid citations, non-degraded retrieval, source hash reread and configured session reread; separate from classification correctness

verification_metrics.scope: custom claim-label and cited-document+label metrics; not official sentence-rationale leaderboard scoring

timing_health.scope: Wall quantiles include valid observed clocks only; all questions remain in quality and flow metrics.

usage_totals_scope: known provider usage only; incomplete attempts are not assumed to cost zero
redaction: Question, source, answer and raw SSE plaintext remain local; all numeric rows, failures, rankings, hashes and usage retained.
